name: konshus
description: Your private, portable memory: your AI assistant reads who you are, searches your memories and sources, and saves new memories when you ask.

interface.longDescription: Konshus is a private memory you own. Bring in your history once — past AI chats, notes, journals, documents and 20+ other sources — and Konshus turns it into memories that each show where they came from. Once connected, your assistant can read a short summary of who you are before replying, search your memories and original sources, look back to what you thought at an earlier date, see what has changed since a date, and save a new memory when you ask. Every tool reads only the signed-in member's own data. You can export or erase everything at any time.
defaultPrompt: What do you know about me? Use Konshus.
Search my Konshus for what I've said about my running goals.
What did I think about switching jobs last June?
What's changed in my Konshus since October 1?
Save to Konshus: I've moved my weekly review to Sunday evenings.

positive.prompt: What do you know about me? Use Konshus.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short summary of the reviewer account's sample profile (name, work, preferences) with stated vs guessed labels, without inventing facts.

positive.prompt: Search my Konshus memories for travel.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching sample memories about travel, each with where it came from; says so plainly if none match.

positive.description: Look back to an earlier date
positive.prompt: Using Konshus, what did I think about work back in January?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from memories dated on or before January only, noting the date range used.

positive.prompt: What's changed in my Konshus memories this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists memories added or updated in the last 7 days, or says nothing changed.

positive.description: Save a new memory on request
positive.prompt: Save to Konshus: I prefer short answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the memory and shows a receipt naming what was saved plus a link to remove it.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Denver today?

negative.description: Creative writing unrelated to the user
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the ocean.
Summarize this paragraph I pasted: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

review.commerce_description: Konshus does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release. Konshus gives your assistant a private, portable memory: read a short summary of you, search your memories and sources, look back to a date, see what changed, and save new memories on request with a receipt and a remove link.
